claims.statement: For the fixed favorable set F(T,p), the primary sum equals the degree-dimension difference in the direct sum of relative simplicial chain complexes (Ind(H_v), Ind(R_v)); in rank and homology terms it is b_(k+1)-b_(k-1)+beta_k-beta_(k-1), where k=p-1.
claims.scope: Retained as an exact algebraic reduction for every finite ordinary tree T and eligible p in the primary contract, with the original selected leaf tags retained with multiplicity. It establishes no sign for the primary sum.
claims.reason: retained: relative degree j-1 has basis precisely the independent j-sets meeting W_v, subtraction of adjacent relative chain dimensions gives the contract sum, and rank-nullity yields the stated formula. The derivation keeps the original fixed selector and every leaf tag. The favorable selector has not been shown to imply the rank/homology inequality needed for S<=0; no full-sum counterexample is asserted.

limitations: The selector condition has not been converted into a bound on relative boundary ranks or homology dimensions.
The rank identity is an algebraic reduction only; it proves neither the primary aggregate nor a refutation.
No computation, primary-literature theorem application, or source replay was used.
